description: USA SSURGO - Flooding Frequency is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. This layer provides an estimate of flood frequency as one of seven classes: None: No reasonable possibility of flooding; one chance out of 500 of flooding in any year or less than 1 time in 500 years. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are esri_landscape, hazards, landscape11, SoilDerivative, water, landscape, risk, hazard. The bounding box given is -180.0000,16.0000,-50.0000,67.0000. The hub shows 2024-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
